edges.subject: aging
edges.quote: Lysosomal dysfunction is a well-recognized feature of aging, yet its systematic molecular investigation remains limited.

edges.subject: Batten disease
edges.quote: Aged lysosomes in brain, heart, muscle and adipose accumulate glycerophosphodiesters and cystine, metabolites that are causally linked to juvenile lysosomal storage disorders like Batten disease.

edges.subject: caloric restriction
edges.quote: Caloric restriction, a lifespan-extending intervention, mitigates these changes in the heart but not the brain.
